Quest Software Launches Quest Lakebase Modeler on Databricks Marketplace

Quest Software announced Quest Lakebase Modeler on November 19, 2026, making the schema modeling tool available through Databricks Marketplace. Quest Lakebase Modeler helps developers, data engineers, and architects design, govern, and deploy application-ready schemas directly within Databricks Lake
